unit: one independently built legitimate delivery per arm
targetSource: exact workflow SHA; clean checkout; application tree must differ from warmup
primaryStop: return of fresh CREATE command; raw response retained
buildCaches: independent local exports from same warmup source; recreate builders and import before each arm
verificationCache: Kyverno image cache disabled; no candidate verification in readiness
retry: at most one full pair, manual evidenced external-failure review, same order/source/database/cache recipe; no GitHub job reruns

campaign.authorization: explicit human declaration bound to final source, configuration, order and database; never inferred from enabled support

vulnerabilityDatabase: first development snapshot preserved; reuse via database_run for subsequent smoke/pilot/campaign pairs at the same source; reject pooled database drift
